You: Let's build it.
Salvage workbench: Field Rifle fabricated.
Warden Ossa: A Warden rifle, built in Ward. Train Rifle in your pack to carry it, equip it in your loadout, and press 8 out here to draw it. Hold fire; it runs bursts on the same charge.
